The two variables are weakly associated in the data. Back pain (the "L back headache" column) appears in 2.0% of patients with R L5 radiculopathy (145 of 7,240) and in 1.5% of those without it (139 of 9,144). That is a small difference, and I did not run a significance test on it. The table can't show which way the effect runs, so I chose the direction from the diagnostic framework in the question. Radiculopathy is a pathophysiological diagnosis, and pain is the symptom it produces, so the cause-and-effect relationship is more likely A.
